Lemon Layer Cake

Ingredients

Cake

  • 2 1/2 cups (300g) Unbleached Cake Flour
  • 1 teaspoon table salt
  • 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
  • 3 large eggs, at room temperature
  • 1 3/4 cups (347g) granulated sugar
  • 2 teaspoons (9g) Pure Vanilla Extract
  • 1/8 teaspoon lemon oil, optional
  • 1 cup (227g) buttermilk, at room temperature
  • 8 tablespoons (113g) butter, softened
  • 1/4 cup (50g) vegetable oil

Frosting

  • 3 cups (340g) confectioners' sugar, sifted
  • 1/4 teaspoon table salt
  • 3 tablespoons (43g) lemon juice
  • 1 tablespoon (6g) grated lemon zest
  • 16 tablespoons (227g) butter, softened

*Bottled lemon juice works, but fresh tastes brighter.

Instructions

  1. To make the cake: Preheat the oven to 350°F with a rack in the center. Grease two 8” x 2” or 9” x 2” round pans and line the bottoms with parchment; if your 8” pans aren’t at least 2” deep, use 9” pans.

  2. Whisk the flour, salt and baking powder together.

  3. Beat the eggs, sugar, vanilla and lemon oil until pale and thick, about 3 minutes.

  4. Warm the buttermilk with the butter until the butter melts, then stir in the oil.

  5. Fold the dry mix into the eggs, then the warm milk mixture, and divide between the pans.

  6. Bake the cakes until golden and springy: 25 to 30 minutes for 9” pans, or 35 to 40 minutes for 8” pans; a thermometer in the center should read 200°F. Cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack.

  7. To make the frosting: Beat the sugar, salt, lemon juice, zest and butter until fluffy.

  8. To assemble the cake: Set one layer on a plate and spread it with a 1/4” to 1/2”-thick layer of frosting. Top with the second layer and frost the top and sides.
